```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML

BLUE = "#003087"; RED = "#c0392b"; ORANGE = "#e67e22"
GREEN = "#27ae60"; PURPLE = "#8e44ad"; TEAL = "#16a085"; GRAY = "#95a5a6"

BASE = dict(font=dict(family="Inter,sans-serif", color="#1a1a2e"),
            paper_bgcolor="white", plot_bgcolor="white")

def fig_base(fig, height=420):
    fig.update_layout(**BASE, height=height,
                      margin=dict(t=40, l=60, r=30, b=50))
    fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False, linecolor="#e8eef5")
    fig.update_yaxes(gridcolor="#f0f0f0", linecolor="#e8eef5")
    return fig
```

```{python}
#| label: data
#| include: false

# ── State life expectancy — NCHS 2021 ────────────────────────────────────────
le = pd.DataFrame({
    "state": ["Hawaii","Minnesota","California","Massachusetts","Connecticut",
               "Colorado","New York","Washington","New Jersey","Vermont",
               "Wisconsin","Oregon","Virginia","Utah","New Hampshire",
               "Nebraska","Iowa","Maryland","Illinois","Kansas",
               "Arizona","Florida","Texas","North Carolina","Pennsylvania",
               "Ohio","Georgia","Michigan","Indiana","Missouri",
               "Nevada","Tennessee","Arkansas","South Carolina","Kentucky",
               "Louisiana","Alabama","Oklahoma","Mississippi","West Virginia"],
    "abbr":  ["HI","MN","CA","MA","CT","CO","NY","WA","NJ","VT",
               "WI","OR","VA","UT","NH","NE","IA","MD","IL","KS",
               "AZ","FL","TX","NC","PA","OH","GA","MI","IN","MO",
               "NV","TN","AR","SC","KY","LA","AL","OK","MS","WV"],
    "le":    [80.7,79.1,79.2,78.9,79.0,78.5,78.6,78.3,78.4,78.5,
               77.8,78.0,77.5,78.2,77.9,77.8,77.7,76.8,77.3,76.6,
               76.9,76.4,76.2,76.0,75.8,75.6,75.4,75.2,75.1,74.9,
               74.8,74.1,73.8,73.6,73.4,73.1,72.9,72.6,72.1,71.8]
})
le["dev"] = (le["le"] - le["le"].mean()).round(1)

# ── Heart disease mortality — CDC 2021-2023, age-std per 100k ────────────────
hd = pd.DataFrame({
    "state": ["MS","OK","AL","AR","TN","WV","LA","KY","SC","IN",
               "MO","GA","MI","OH","TX","NC","PA","FL","AZ","IL",
               "VA","OR","WI","CO","MD","NY","WA","MN","NJ","CA",
               "MA","CT","VT","HI","UT"],
    "rate":  [343,338,332,328,322,318,315,312,305,298,
               295,290,285,280,275,272,232,228,225,222,
               218,212,208,202,210,188,178,175,168,170,
               162,185,182,155,148]
})
hd["above_avg"] = hd["rate"] > hd["rate"].mean()

# ── Heart disease by race — CDC national 2021-2023 ───────────────────────────
hd_race = pd.DataFrame({
    "race": ["Black/African American","White","American Indian/AK Native",
              "Hispanic","Asian/Pacific Islander"],
    "rate": [296, 215, 232, 162, 105]
}).sort_values("rate")

# ── Obesity trend — BRFSS national 2011-2022 ─────────────────────────────────
obesity = pd.DataFrame({
    "year": list(range(2011, 2023)),
    "pct":  [27.2,27.9,29.4,29.9,30.4,30.8,31.2,31.7,32.2,32.8,33.9,34.3]
})

# ── National LE trend by race — NCHS 2011-2021 ───────────────────────────────
le_race = pd.DataFrame({
    "year": list(range(2011,2022))*3,
    "race": ["White"]*11 + ["Black"]*11 + ["Hispanic"]*11,
    "le":   [78.8,78.8,78.7,78.7,78.5,78.4,78.3,78.5,78.7,77.2,76.5,
              74.7,75.0,75.1,75.4,75.5,75.4,75.1,75.3,75.3,71.8,70.8,
              81.8,81.8,81.5,81.6,81.4,81.1,81.4,81.8,82.0,78.0,77.7]
})

print("Data ready.")
```

---

<div class="abstract-box">
<h4>Abstract</h4>
Americans living just miles apart can face life expectancy differences of **more than 8 years**
depending on which state they live in. This report examines geographic and demographic disparities
in longevity and heart disease mortality using CDC public health statistics. The data show that
health in America is not determined solely by biology or behavior — it is profoundly shaped by
**place**.

**Sources:** NCHS State Life Expectancy 2021 · CDC Heart Disease Mortality 2021–2023 ·
CDC BRFSS Obesity Trends · All from data.cdc.gov
</div>

---

## The Geography of Life and Death

The United States ranks **46th globally** in life expectancy despite spending more per capita on
healthcare than any other nation. Behind that average lies a country of profound internal contrasts.

<div class="pull-quote">
"The gap in life expectancy between the best- and worst-performing states has not narrowed in
over 30 years — and in some measures it is growing."
</div>

```{python}
#| label: fig-le-map
#| fig-cap: "Life expectancy at birth by U.S. state, 2021. Source: NCHS."

fig = px.choropleth(le, locations="abbr", locationmode="USA-states",
                    color="le", color_continuous_scale="Blues", scope="usa",
                    hover_name="state",
                    hover_data={"abbr": False, "le": ":.1f"},
                    labels={"le": "Life Expectancy (yrs)"})
fig.update_layout(**BASE, height=420,
                  geo=dict(bgcolor="white", lakecolor="white", landcolor="#f8faff"),
                  coloraxis_colorbar=dict(title="Years", len=0.6),
                  margin=dict(t=20, l=0, r=0, b=0))
fig.show()
```

---

## The State Divide

```{python}
#| label: fig-le-bar
#| fig-cap: "States ranked by life expectancy. Red/blue shading shows deviation from the national average."

le_s = le.sort_values("le")
nat  = le["le"].mean()

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=le_s["abbr"], y=le_s["le"],
    marker=dict(color=le_s["dev"], colorscale="RdBu", cmid=0,
                showscale=True, colorbar=dict(title="vs avg", len=0.6)),
    customdata=le_s[["state","le","dev"]].values,
    hovertemplate="<b>%{customdata[0]}</b><br>%{customdata[1]:.1f} yrs "
                  "(%{customdata[2]:+.1f})<extra></extra>"
))
fig.add_hline(y=nat, line_dash="dash", line_color=RED, line_width=2,
              annotation_text=f"Avg: {nat:.1f} yrs", annotation_font_color=RED,
              annotation_position="top right")
fig = fig_base(fig, 400)
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis=dict(tickangle=-45, title=""),
    yaxis=dict(title="Life Expectancy (years)",
               range=[le_s["le"].min()-0.5, le_s["le"].max()+0.5]),
    showlegend=False)
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
best = le.sort_values("le").iloc[-1]
worst = le.sort_values("le").iloc[0]
gap = best["le"] - worst["le"]
HTML(f"""
<div class="stat-grid">
  <div class="stat-card green"><div class="stat-value">{best['le']}</div>
    <div class="stat-label">Highest — {best['abbr']}</div></div>
  <div class="stat-card red"><div class="stat-value">{worst['le']}</div>
    <div class="stat-label">Lowest — {worst['abbr']}</div></div>
  <div class="stat-card orange"><div class="stat-value">{gap:.1f} yrs</div>
    <div class="stat-label">State Gap</div></div>
  <div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">{nat:.1f}</div>
    <div class="stat-label">National Average</div></div>
</div>""")
```

::: {.callout-important}
## The Inequality Hidden in Averages
A child born in West Virginia (71.8 yrs) faces nearly **9 fewer years of life** than one born in
Hawaii (80.7 yrs) — not because of choices, but because of place.
:::

---

## Heart Disease: America's #1 Killer

Heart disease has been the leading cause of death in the US every year since 1950 —
**700,000 deaths annually**, one person every 34 seconds. Its burden is not random.

```{python}
#| label: fig-hd-map
#| fig-cap: "Age-standardized heart disease mortality per 100,000 adults (35+) by state, 2021–2023. Source: CDC."

fig = px.choropleth(hd, locations="state", locationmode="USA-states",
                    color="rate", color_continuous_scale="YlOrRd", scope="usa",
                    hover_name="state", hover_data={"rate": ":.0f"},
                    labels={"rate": "Deaths per 100k"})
fig.update_layout(**BASE, height=420,
                  geo=dict(bgcolor="white", lakecolor="white", landcolor="#f8faff"),
                  coloraxis_colorbar=dict(title="Rate", len=0.6),
                  margin=dict(t=20, l=0, r=0, b=0))
fig.show()
```

### The Stroke Belt

```{python}
#| label: fig-hd-rank
#| fig-cap: "States ranked by heart disease mortality rate. Red = above national average."

hd_s = hd.sort_values("rate")
avg_hd = hd["rate"].mean()

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=hd_s["state"], y=hd_s["rate"],
    marker_color=[RED if a else BLUE for a in hd_s["above_avg"]],
    hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b>  %{y:.0f} per 100k<extra></extra>"
))
fig.add_hline(y=avg_hd, line_dash="dash", line_color="#333", line_width=1.5,
              annotation_text=f"Avg: {avg_hd:.0f}", annotation_position="top left")
fig = fig_base(fig, 400)
fig.update_layout(xaxis=dict(tickangle=-45, title=""),
                  yaxis=dict(title="Rate (per 100,000)"), showlegend=False)
fig.show()
```

---

## Racial Disparities in Heart Disease

```{python}
#| label: fig-race
#| fig-cap: "Heart disease mortality by race/ethnicity, national estimates. Source: CDC 2021–2023."

race_colors = {"Black/African American": RED, "White": BLUE,
               "American Indian/AK Native": PURPLE,
               "Hispanic": ORANGE, "Asian/Pacific Islander": TEAL}
colors = [race_colors.get(r, GRAY) for r in hd_race["race"]]

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=hd_race["race"], y=hd_race["rate"],
    marker_color=colors,
    text=hd_race["rate"], textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b><br>%{y} per 100k<extra></extra>"
))
fig = fig_base(fig, 400)
fig.update_layout(xaxis=dict(title=""), yaxis=dict(title="Rate (per 100,000)"),
                  showlegend=False)
fig.show()
```

::: {.callout-note}
## Structural, Not Biological
Black Americans face heart disease mortality rates **38% higher** than white Americans. This
reflects inequitable access to healthcare, food, housing, and economic opportunity — not
inherent biological differences.
:::

## Life Expectancy Trends by Race

```{python}
#| label: fig-le-race
#| fig-cap: "National life expectancy trends by race, 2011–2021. The COVID-19 impact (2020–2021) hit Black and Hispanic Americans hardest. Source: NCHS."

race_pal = {"White": BLUE, "Black": RED, "Hispanic": ORANGE}

fig = px.line(le_race, x="year", y="le", color="race",
              color_discrete_map=race_pal, markers=True,
              labels={"le": "Life Expectancy (yrs)", "year": "Year", "race": ""})
fig.add_vrect(x0=2019.5, x1=2021.5, fillcolor="#fff3cd", opacity=0.4,
              line_width=0, annotation_text="COVID-19",
              annotation_position="top left", annotation_font_size=11)
fig = fig_base(fig, 400)
fig.update_layout(xaxis=dict(dtick=1),
                  legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.08))
fig.show()
```

## Obesity: The Modifiable Driver

```{python}
#| label: fig-obesity
#| fig-cap: "National adult obesity prevalence trend, BRFSS 2011–2022. The upward trajectory has been unbroken for over a decade."

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=obesity["year"], y=obesity["pct"],
    mode="lines+markers",
    line=dict(color=RED, width=3), marker=dict(size=8),
    fill="tozeroy", fillcolor="rgba(192,57,43,0.08)",
    hovertemplate="<b>%{x}</b> — %{y:.1f}% obese<extra></extra>"
))
fig = fig_base(fig, 380)
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis=dict(title="Year", dtick=1),
    yaxis=dict(title="Adult Obesity Prevalence (%)", range=[24, 37]),
    showlegend=False
)
fig.show()
```

---

## The Convergence: Where Risk Overlaps

```{python}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Life expectancy vs. heart disease rate by state. The negative relationship confirms that high cardiovascular burden and short lifespans cluster in the same places."

merged = pd.merge(le[["abbr","state","le"]], hd[["state","rate"]],
                  left_on="abbr", right_on="state", how="inner")

z = np.polyfit(merged["rate"], merged["le"], 1)
x_line = np.linspace(merged["rate"].min(), merged["rate"].max(), 100)

fig = px.scatter(merged, x="rate", y="le", text="abbr",
                 color="le", color_continuous_scale="RdBu",
                 labels={"rate": "Heart Disease Mortality (per 100k)",
                         "le": "Life Expectancy (yrs)"},
                 hover_data={"state_y": True, "rate": ":.0f", "le": ":.1f"})
fig.update_traces(textposition="top center", textfont=dict(size=9))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x_line, y=np.poly1d(z)(x_line), mode="lines",
                          line=dict(color=ORANGE, dash="dash", width=2),
                          name="Trend", showlegend=True))
fig = fig_base(fig, 480)
fig.update_layout(coloraxis_showscale=False)
fig.show()
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Place, Not Just Choice
The geographic overlap of low life expectancy, high heart disease, and high obesity across the
same states — decade after decade — points to structural causes that no amount of individual
behavior change alone can address.
:::

## Conclusions

<div class="pull-quote">
"Treating heart disease one patient at a time, while the conditions that cause it remain
unchanged, is like mopping the floor with the tap still running."
</div>

Your zip code remains one of the strongest predictors of your lifespan in America. Effective
intervention must operate at the level where disparities originate: housing, food systems,
healthcare access, economic opportunity, and environmental conditions. This report identifies
where those interventions are most urgently needed.
